title: GPT-5.6 helps prove an exact mapping between frustrated and field-driven spin chains
summary: A single-author preprint proves that every finite one-dimensional open O(n) spin chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interactions has an exact, temperature-independent Hamiltonian mapping to a simpler nearest-neighbor chain with axial single-spin potentials. A parallel result for q-state Potts chains yields a closed-form solution for every q ≥ 2 and finite chain length. The theorem generalizes a 1990 Heisenberg-chain challenge and connects spontaneous collective behavior from competing interactions to field-induced behavior.
ai_technology: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol; GPT-5.6 Sol Pro for final adversarial manuscript review

The theorem concerns classical one-dimensional open chains and exact Hamiltonian mappings; the paper discusses possible experimental relevance but reports no experimental test. The author assumes responsibility for reviewing and verifying AI-generated content; Mathematica 14.3 was also used to verify results.

The author identified the hidden reciprocity, extended the theorem to arbitrary spatial inhomogeneity, and states that all AI-generated scientific content was reviewed and verified. GPT-5.6 Sol Pro conducted a final adversarial review.
